
### collision detection  {.smaller}

* Wi-Fi: use ACKs to detect if transmission successful
* problem 1: transmit whole packet, then know about collision 
* problem 2: need to reserve time for ACK to be sent after each packet
<hr class="vspace" />
* alternate idea: listen for collision, stop transmitting early
* doesn't work on wireless
  * can't hear other transmissions while transmitting on same channel
* does work on some wired shared media
